title: Laddu and the Super-Melty Rainbow Gola
moral: When we share, everyone gets a happy rainbow.
description: Laddu wins a GIANT seven-colour Rainbow Gola at the Masti Nagar market, and he wants to eat it ALL by himself! But the sun is hot, Chintu's fan plan goes whoosh, and Golu the goat is very hungry. Learn the seven colours of the rainbow with Laddu, Chintu, Pinky, Dadaji and Golu in this funny animated story about sharing for kids aged 3 to 8.
outro: Remember, friends: when we share, everyone gets a happy rainbow! And Golu says... the paper cup was yummy! Ba-a-a-a! See you tomorrow... bye-bye!

narration.text: Pitter-patter, pitter-patter... the rain stopped in Masti Nagar! And guess what popped up in the sky?
Laddu! Look up! A big, beautiful RAINBOW!
narration.speaker: chintu

narration.text: Ooh! It looks like a giant stripy jalebi! Arre wah, jalebi time!
narration.speaker: laddu

narration.text: Laddu jumped for joy... and SPLOOSH! He slipped right into a puddle! Wibble-wobble!
Silly Laddu! A rainbow is not a jalebi. A rainbow has SEVEN colours. Let's count them together! One, two, three, four, five, six, SEVEN!

narration.text: At the market, the gola cart had a big sign. Name all seven rainbow colours, and win a GIANT Rainbow Gola!
Easy-peasy! Red... orange... yellow... green... blue... and... JALEBI!
narration.speaker: laddu

narration.text: Ha ha! Jalebi is not a colour, Laddu! Friends, the rainbow starts with RED. What colour comes after red?
ORANGE! Yes! Red, orange, yellow, green, blue...
And the last two are INDIGO and VIOLET! Dark blue and purple!
narration.speaker: chintu

narration.text: DING-DING! A giant Rainbow Gola for Laddu! It was as tall as Golu!

Ho ho HO! Now... where are my glasses? Oh! On my head! And they're... purple!
